title: Weekly clash run inside Revit by solid intersection across open cloud models; penetrations separated, clashes grouped, owner by routing priority
use_when: A federated project needs a weekly clash number per discipline pair and the cloud project has no clash service (no Model Coordination module)
Clash results must carry element unique ids so next week's run can report new and resolved clashes
A quick hard-clash check before publishing models for formal coordination
not_for: Clearance (soft) clashes: needs inflated solids, not recorded yet
Walls and floors against services when the service openings are not modelled: every crossing would count
Models that do not share one internal origin and shared position: transform one side by the link transform first
Replacing a coordination service where one is available: use its tracked clash groups instead

environment.model: Autodesk sample Snowdon Towers, 6 cloud discipline models; 9 pairs

changelog.change: First recorded (IN-0017, curator session with the owner)
